_comment: 10 verified v2ray subscription sources. The checker runs every 6h and reads this file fresh each time. After editing, just commit/push — the workflow picks it up automatically on the next run.

subscriptions.name: 0xRadikal
subscriptions._note: Updates every 15 min. VLESS Reality, Hysteria2, VMess, Trojan, SS. ~100 configs.

subscriptions.name: Kwinshadow-TVC
subscriptions._note: Active fork of yebekhe/TelegramV2rayCollector (original repo was deleted). Aggregates from telegram channels. ~84 configs.

subscriptions.name: barry-far
subscriptions._note: Updates every 15 min. Plain-text sub (NOT base64). ~453 configs. NOTE: old URL 'V2ray-Configs' repo was blocked by GitHub (DMCA); this is the live 'V2ray-config' repo.

subscriptions.name: ircfspace-tvc
subscriptions._note: Iranian Cloudflare Community aggregator. Hourly. VLESS, VMess, Trojan, TUIC, Hysteria2. ~50 configs.

subscriptions.name: MahanKenway
subscriptions._note: Updates every 2 hours. Plain-text mix of all protocols. ~1500 configs.

subscriptions.name: mahdibland
subscriptions._note: Biggest single source — ~4049 configs. Plain text.

subscriptions.name: miladtahanian
subscriptions._note: Updates every 30 min. Iran-focused mix. ~372 configs.

subscriptions.name: V2RayRoot
subscriptions._note: Telegram @V2RayRootFree. Iran-operator-tagged configs. Shadowsocks-only file (~301 configs) chosen because our top50 is mostly SS anyway.

subscriptions.name: iboxz
subscriptions._note: Updates every 2 hours. Reality, VLESS, VMess, Trojan, SS mix. ~369 configs.

subscriptions.name: Farid-Karimi
subscriptions._note: Updates every 12 hours. Iran-focused mix. ~733 configs.
